Season 4 has been underway for a month and the top tier builds are fairly set in stone if you are looking to crack the leaderboards. This post will list the top solo builds. I will post again soon with the top team builds and team setups.

Barbarian - 2WW/6IK Rend Build

http://www.diablofans.com/builds/58478-s4-solo-gr65-2ww-6ik-rend-build

There are a few Barb builds cracking the leaderboards this season but Alkaizer is crushing the competition with this Rend build. This build is a standard WotB CotA WW build where your IK set provides the necessary CDR to keep your buffs up permanently.

Crusader - Hammerdin (Stutter Step)

http://www.diablofans.com/builds/57651-bane-of-the-hammerdin

I've used this build to crack the solo Crusader leaderboards and I can vouch that it is the most fun I've had on the crusader yet. The strategy is simple, keep Akarat up, spam hammers and ensure you engage the enemy while Convention of Elements is on Holy. The stutter stepping takes a bit getting used to but the Hexing Pants bonus is unparalleled. Their are some people getting on the leader boards without stutter stepping, and you can simply change the hexing pants to a Leoric's in the cube for the extra CDR. On the build page, the author uses a Skycutter. I would highly suggest wearing the Johanna's Flail and cubing a Furnace for the extra elite damage. The other change that has been seen on the leaderboards in the past few days, is swapping the Gogok for a Pain Enhancer. In order for this to work, ensure that you have CDR on your shoulders and gloves, and that your Pain Enhancer is rank 50+. I also disagree with the author's suggestion to go for reduce resource cost. With Provoke and enough attack speed, Obsidian Ring will ensure you never run out of resource and CDR is much more important IMO.

Demon Hunter 1: Natalya's Build

http://www.diablofans.com/builds/57534-2-3-gr60-65-lightning-natalya-rov

I have yet to play the DH builds this season though I have almost finished gearing for them. I will update this with any suggestions I have within the week.

Demon Hunter 2: Unhallowed Multishot

http://www.diablofans.com/builds/57399-2-3-multishot-basic-build-variations-gr60

I have yet to play the DH builds this season though I have almost finished gearing for them. I will update this with any suggestions I have within the week. This Multishot build is a new S4 build and seems to be a viable alternative on the DH leaderboards (if you aren't trying to push the top 20 spots.)

Monk - Uliana's Monk

http://www.diablofans.com/builds/57405-quin69-gr71-ulianas-monk

As usual, Quin69 has put together an awesome Monk build. This build is quick and destructive and blows the Spirit Generator builds from before S4 out of the water.

Witch Doctor - Zombie Bears Helltooth

http://www.diablofans.com/builds/57408-2-3-66-zombie-bears-firewall-helltooth

The Helltooth set is dominating the leader boards this season, and the new mojo, Henri's Perquisition, makes the Witch Doc feel like a tank that deals a shit ton of damage.This build and it's variation below, use the Necrosis effect to boost your damage output through the roof. IMO the benefit of this build vs. the one below is Mana availability. The scrimshaw lowers the cost of Zombie Bears enough to make it out DPS the acid cloud build, given that you have a great Ancient Scrimshaw and Henri's. Otherwise, the acid cloud build is great as a stepping stone as you look for the perfect weapon and mojo.

Witch Doctor - Acid Cloud Helltooth

http://www.diablofans.com/builds/57477-2-3-acid-cloud-65-grifts-helltooth-fire-and-ice

This build swaps Zombie Bears for Acid Cloud and makes use of the superior damage of a two-handed staff. You may run into mana issues with this build but Your damage output while casting your main DPS skill will increase.

Wizard - Vyr's Archon Wizard

http://www.diablofans.com/builds/57538-quin69-gr66-vyrs-archon-wizard

This wizard build hinges on the set bonus of the Chantodo's and the Swami Wizard Hat. The idea is to build your stacks as high as possible while in Archon (this is particulary easy when spamming the primary Archon skill.) Then while out of Archon, the obsidian ring procs while using Arcance Torrent. Your down time between Archons should be very short, but it shouldn't matter because your stacks will give you the DPS needed to manage while out of Archon.
